actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 is the exact rejected full-resolution generated PNG editing target. Image2 is the unchanged original small card, sole authority for actual head angle, hair, clothes, crop and lighting. Image3 supplies user mascot identity and compact near-round anatomy only.
Correct ONLY the pointed lower yellow face/neck funnel at the pale khaki shirt opening. The yellow lower contour currently descends diagonally into a sharp point below the mouth. Remove this elongated pointed segment and finish ONE COMPACT NEAR-ROUND head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin close below the closed mouth, immediately contacting a RAISED and BROADENED existing shirt neckline. Keep throat exposure minimal, a very short broad transition, no separate yellow neck shaft, V funnel, pinched narrow human collar, neck rolls, floating cloth, clipping or cream belly bib. Broaden the collar and raise its front/rear edges coherently around the rounded head base, with correct cloth overlap and contact shadows. Do not copy the human source long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy. Keep the original actual exact primary angle and head roll; do not rotate into a frontal pose to conceal the issue.
Preserve already correct exact source appearance: Actual BROWN/OLIVE peaked military cap with GOLD central badge and dark brown band/BLACK visor, exposed short GREY/BROWN temple hair and real brow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth. BROWN/OLIVE OPEN-lapel military coat, PALE KHAKI shirt collar and DARK NAVY/BLACK necktie, only primary-exposed small GOLD collar/shoulder areas. Keep exact primary mild angle/roll, grey light/backing and note-limited crop. No spectacles, moustache/chin beard, closed high collar or hidden chest regalia; fine cap engraving indefinite. Keep entire tilted dark frame, OPAQUE grey photographic backing and actual cream lower-right note overlap. No invented readable text, medals, moustache/beard or spectacles. Genuine alpha only outside the entire framed card, all internal cloth/backing/skin/hat surfaces opaque.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
